serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin, each bucket's own table for bookedMin, service_capacities reserved_minutes as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled service minutes available; bookedMin is authoritative load from the bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is the service_capacities reserved figure, kept only so its drift stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity.

orderCapacity.note: Static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series; daily_order_capacity is the UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity'; null means not configured rather than a ceiling of zero.
